title: Rank-preserving contraction for anticanonical fibrations
exact_target: Let X be smooth connected projective complex with no nonzero holomorphic q-forms for $q>0$ and smoothly semipositive $L=-K_X$; let an algebraic torus T act naturally on L. Take a T-invariant dominant rational $f:X\dashrightarrow Z$ to smooth connected projective Z with C(Z) relatively algebraically closed in C(X). On a resolution $Y\to X$ and $Y\to Z$, require a nonzero invariant positive L-multiple on the generic fiber and require invariant section dimension of $K_{Y/X}+mL$ on that fiber to be one for every positive multiple of some a. Must either X have a positive T-invariant anticanonical section, or f factor through a smooth projective W of smaller dimension retaining both generic-fiber properties and relative algebraic closure?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
